subject: Configuration section
notes: LANDED 2026-08-17 (with PB60 / AR-15.67.3-5). The container's configuration section applies to each directly or indirectly contained program: DataBinder.InheritConfiguration copies the whole configuration-derived state (SPECIAL-NAMES — DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, CURRENCY SIGN, CLASS names, ALPHABETs, switch mnemonics and status condition-names; OBJECT-COMPUTER's PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE; SOURCE-COMPUTER's DEBUGGING MODE; the REPOSITORY function/intrinsic/property specifiers) into every containee before it binds; the device-name mnemonics (Format 4, DISPLAY UPON / ACCEPT FROM) were already inherited by MnemonicRegistry's enclosing-unit walk — a second, tree-walking mechanism for the same rule, correct today and noted for folding into InheritConfiguration when the environment division gets a bound model. Implicit entries (the implied CURRENCY SIGN '$', the native alphabet) inherit as the defaults. Goldens: the 2023 one (six SPECIAL-NAMES/OBJECT-COMPUTER legs through a contained program, plus OPTIONS) and the 85 one (the edition-invariant five).
